title: Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Act 1989

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 1989
ACT IX OF 1989
SINDH GOVERNMENT
SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th May, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-4/89, dated
27-5-1989.--The Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Bill,
1989 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 9th April, 1989
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th May, 1989 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Government Benevolent
Fund (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance XIV of 1960

ACT IX OF 1989
ACT IX OF 1989
SINDH GOVERNMENT
SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th May, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-4/89, dated
27-5-1989.--The Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Bill,
1989 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 9th April, 1989
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th May, 1989 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Sindh Ordinance XIV of 1960.--In the Sindh Government Servants Benevolent
Fund Ordinance, 1960, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section
2--
(i) for clause
(a), the following shall be substituted:--
"(a)
"family" in relation to a Government servants means--
(i) wife or
wives in the case of male and husband in the case of a female; and
(ii) the
legitimate and step children, below twenty-one years, parents, minor brothers,
and unmarried, divorced or widowed sisters wholly dependent upon him or
her;";
(iii) clauses
(c) and (f) shall be omitted.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6 of Sindh Ordinance XIV of 1960

ACT IX OF 1989
ACT IX OF 1989
SINDH GOVERNMENT
SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th May, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-4/89, dated
27-5-1989.--The Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Bill,
1989 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 9th April, 1989
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th May, 1989 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
5. Amendment of section 6 of
Sindh Ordinance XIV of 1960.--(1) In the said Ordinance, for section 6, the
following shall be substituted:--
"6. Boards
of Management.--(1) As soon as may be, Government shall, in such manner as
may be prescribed, constitute the following Boards of Management, namely:--
(a) the
Provincial Board of Management;
(b) the
Divisional Board of Management for each Division; and
(c) the
Secretariat Board of Management;
(2) Subject to such directions as
may be issued by Government and such rules as may be made in this behalf--
(a) the
Provincial Board of Management shall have the powers to--
(i) invest
moneys credited to the Fund;
(ii) incur
expenditure from the Fund;
(iii) allocate
funds to the Divisional and Secretariat Boards of Management; and
(iv) constitute
a committee for providing relief from the Funds to Government servants holding
posts in Basic Pay Scale 16 and above and their families;
(b) a Divisional
Board of Management shall subject to such directions as may be issued by the
Provincial Board of Management---
(i) deal with
all matters connected with the Fund allocated to it;
(ii) provide
relief to the Government servants holding posts in Basic Pay Scale 1 to Basic
Pay Scale 15 in their respective Divisions and sanction expenditure;
(c) the
Secretariat Board of Management shall subject to such directions as may be
issued by the Provincial Board of Management--
(i) deal with
all matters connected with the Fund allocated to it;
(ii) provide
relief to the Government servants holding posts in Basic Pay Scale 1 to Basic
Pay Scale 15 and sanction expenditure."
